source_policy: 宗门旧等级/费用/效果/计数/奖励原值保留；新事务ID/日志及导入历史支出边界为明确项目设计。不是热血江湖官方门派规则。
class_requirement: all14classes, story artifact binding not equipped sword

donation.mainline_reserve: 原bamboo_partition_policy统一保护；明确inventory至少3付款，Q002活跃时付款后两携带分区合计仍保R，不把行囊当远程输入。

counter_policy: preserve exact adventure lifetime counts, not journey valley/north counters. Every3 qualifies next explicit round; claim count never reset by scene/death. Same source counter may satisfy distinct explicitly named sect and old one-time commission rewards, each own receipt; no shared boolean.

ledger.earned: total actually received contribution, never decremented by costs
ledger.legacy_unclassified_spend: at import earned-available-promotion prefix; must be >=0, preserve as historical opening spend without inventing previous potion/ore purchases
ledger.equation: earned = available + promotion_spend + legacy_unclassified_spend + new_exchange_spend + explicit_other_recorded_spend; explicit configuration adjustments separately tagged
ledger.commission_history: preserve exact original3claimed-round counters; do not recompute earned from kills because donation/history is not in old save
ledger.bad_ledger: reject negative/contradictory source/overflow, never clamp/refund/replay reward

import_mapping.legacy_source_preconditions: source bound stage if any nondefault sect; original old level and journey/story prerequisites verified before mapping
import_mapping.no_new_promotion: rank preserved exactly, no auto promotion from converted level or earned
import_mapping.source_default_initialization: schema1/2 old missing sect/adventure normalization uses only already specified version-specific defaults

transaction_policy: alive/idle/out of combat/no active challenge,2.5m explicit service; quote stable action/rank/counter revision. Validate material/currency/output bag/weight before committing. Failed exchange leaves contribution and counters, repeated requests do not spend/earn twice; rank3 rejects further promotion. Shop sale does not create contribution.
open_dependencies: imported target strict profile field mapping
runtime NPC services/ledger and save/fault tests
full project sect expansion beyond preserved3ranks not inferred from twelve character ranks

event_source_mapping.recipient: authoritative killing credit character; no implicit party share
event_source_mapping.stage_gate: none; even prebinding kills count but claiming service still requires binding

event_source_mapping.recipient: authoritative killing credit character; no implicit party share
last accepted hit actor, same as fixed bamboo drop owner
event_source_mapping.stage_gate: none; only actual valid gathering action

event_receipt_policy: counter increment and death/harvest result commit together with root/generation/action receipt. If0..max integer would overflow reject event/configuration before mutation, never legacy saturating_add. Do not rewalk source inventory to recompute harvested counters.

event_evidence.death_excerpt: match kind.as_str(): boar -> boars_defeated; mountain_wolf -> wolves_defeated; all others unchanged
event_evidence.gather_excerpt: increment bamboo_harvested only inside node.hits == rules.gathering.hits branch
